chapters.title: The founding
chapters.text:
This book began from an imported campaign. Its founding details were incomplete.

The founding party of 10 residents arrived. Kauppi and Sigfrid Bjarnardóttir were already partners at arrival. Daugirdė and Áilu were already partners at arrival. Eaddis Olafsdóttir and Conán were already partners at arrival.
